draft_en.subject: Second ODM source for the Klemsan-label industrial switches
draft_en.body:
Hello Klemsan team,

Over the past months you had a product mail from us - "24 Port PoE Managed Switch" on 20 August 2026 - and there was no reason to answer a mass mail. This one is specific.

For the industrial Ethernet switches sold under the Klemsan label, we can be a second ODM source in your packaging from small lots, DIN-rail, -40 to 75 C, CE/RoHS: 8 x Gigabit + 2 x SFP unmanaged - model STI-280GE - $46 USD EXW (MOQ 1, 15-day validity); 5 x Gigabit unmanaged - STI-050GE - $18.5; 8 x PoE+ + 2 x SFP L2 managed (VLAN, QoS, IGMP), Marvell-based - STI-288GPM - $85.5.

One question: which SKU would you want sampled against your current Volktek unit first?

Best regards,
Alan
Saga Telecom - sagatele.com
